prompts.classify: Which category best matches {path}? Judge the latest customer message; earlier turns are context only.
prompts.escalation: The customer is asking to talk to a human agent, or is frustrated enough that a human should take over.
prompts.frustration: How frustrated is this customer? Judge the latest message, with earlier turns as context.
prompts.other: None of the other options fit the customer's latest message, or the message is too vague to place.

escalationReply: Let me hand this to a live agent. I have passed along our conversation so far, so you will not have to repeat yourself.
clarifyReply: I'm not sure I follow yet. Can you say a bit more about what you were doing and what went wrong?

root.name: initial_message
root.response: Hi! I'm the support bot. Tell me what's going on and I'll point you to the right place.

children.name: account
children.label: Sign-in, passwords, MFA, profile details, team members, roles and permissions, or closing an account. Not about money.
children.response: Happy to help with your account. Is this about signing in, your profile details, or closing the account?

children.name: login_access
children.label: Cannot sign in, locked out, password reset, MFA or SSO trouble.
children.response: Let's get you back in. Do you want a one-time code, a password reset, or should I pull in a person?

children.name: request_otp
children.label: Wants a one-time code or a sign-in link, or the code that was sent never arrived.
children.response: Done — a fresh sign-in code is on its way to {{account.emailOnFile}}. It lands in under a minute and works for 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it.

children.name: reset_password
children.label: Forgot the password, the password is rejected, or wants to set a new one.
children.response: Sent — the reset link is in your inbox at {{account.emailOnFile}}. It works until {{account.lastPasswordReset.linkExpiresAt}}. Open it and choose a new password.

children.name: live_agent
children.label: Locked out in a way self-serve cannot fix: no access to the email on file, MFA backup codes lost, a disabled account, or suspected fraud.

children.name: profile_settings
children.label: Change name, email, notification settings or other profile fields.
children.response: You are {{account.name}} ({{account.emailOnFile}}, {{emailState}}), {{account.role}} of {{account.org}}. Notifications: {{notificationFlags}}. Change any of it under Settings > Profile — a new email needs a confirmation click in the message we send there.

children.name: close_account
children.label: Delete the account, export data, or leave the product for good.
children.response: I started the data export for {{account.org}}. It is ready by {{account.dataExport.readyAt}} at {{account.dataExport.url}}. Closing the account comes after that, and it cannot be undone — tell me when you want to take that step.

children.name: subscription
children.label: Plans, pricing, upgrades, downgrades, renewals, invoices, payment methods, charges and refunds. Anything about money.
children.response: Let's sort out your plan. Is it about changing the plan, cancelling, an invoice, or a payment?

children.name: change_plan
children.label: Upgrade, downgrade, compare plans, add or remove seats.
children.response: You are on {{subscription.plan}} at {{subscription.pricePerSeat}} a seat, {{seatUsage}}, which bills {{subscription.monthlyTotal}} a month and renews {{subscription.renewsOn}}. The plans are {{allPlans}}. Switch under Billing > Plan: upgrades apply now and are prorated, downgrades at the next renewal.

children.name: cancel
children.label: Cancel the subscription, stop auto-renew, or pause the plan.
children.response: Sorry to see you go. Do you want to cancel it yourself, or talk to someone first?

children.name: cancel_self_serve
children.label: Just wants to stop the plan or turn off auto-renew, and can do it in the product.
children.response: Cancel under Billing > Plan > Cancel. Auto-renew is currently {{subscription.autoRenew}} for your {{subscription.billingPeriod}} {{subscription.plan}} plan, so you keep access until {{subscription.renewsOn}} — you have already paid for that time.

children.name: live_agent
children.label: The cancellation needs a person: a refund, a contract or annual deal, a dispute, or the customer is unhappy and asking for someone.

children.name: invoice_receipt
children.label: Find an invoice or receipt, fix tax or company details on it.
children.response: You have {{invoiceCount}} under Billing > History. The latest is {{latestInvoice}}. They are billed to {{subscription.billingDetails.companyName}}, tax ID {{subscription.billingDetails.taxId}}. You can edit those details there and download any PDF again.

children.name: payment_problem
children.label: Card declined, failed payment, double charge, or a refund request.
children.response: Let's fix the payment. Is it a card that needs updating, or something a person should look at?

children.name: update_card
children.label: A card was declined or has expired, and the customer wants to fix the payment method and retry.
children.response: Retry queued on {{failedInvoice}} with the {{cardLabel}}. Billing > History updates within a few minutes.

children.name: live_agent
children.label: The money question needs a person: a refund, a double charge, a disputed amount, or an invoice that cannot be paid online.

children.name: technical
children.label: The product is broken, slow, throwing errors, or the user needs help using a feature or the API. Not about money or account access.
children.response: Let's dig into it. Do you need the docs, a common fix, or should I file a bug?

children.name: see_docs
children.label: Asks how a feature or the API works, wants a guide or an example.
children.response: The docs are at /docs, and the API reference with copy-paste examples is at /docs/api. You are on {{technical.sdk}} — {{versionNote}}.

children.name: troubleshoot_common
children.label: A known or common problem: sync stuck, upload fails, slow page.
children.response: I can see it: {{syncNote}} {{incidentNote}} Three things usually clear it: sign out and back in, clear the site cache, then retry the action. Storage is {{storageUsage}} in {{technical.region}}.

children.name: report_bug
children.label: Reports something clearly broken or wrong that needs engineering.
children.response: Filed {{ticket}} for you: {{technical.lastError.message}}. I attached {{technical.browser}}, {{technical.sdk}} and request id {{technical.lastError.requestId}}. Engineering picks it up from there.

children.name: live_agent
children.label: Explicitly asks for a human, a real person, an agent, or a manager, or says the bot is not helping. Also legal and security matters.
children.response: Let me connect you with an agent.
